python3 -c "
import parse
# Test various alignment formats
tests = [
    ('{:>10}', 'hello'),
    ('{:<10}', 'world'),
    ('{:^10}', 'test'),
    ('{:10}', 'value'),
]
for fmt, val in tests:
    try:
        p = parse.Parser(fmt)
        result = p.parse(val.rjust(10))
        print(f'{fmt!r} -> {result}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{fmt!r} -> Error: {e}')
"
